text: The Tree Brace is a Key Item in . It can be obtained in the Gormott Province during the quest Nature Boy.

Tirkin Kountess 2 is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Empire of Mor Ardain during the Blade Quest Birds of a Feather, after defeating the Tirkin King in battle. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Earth Mastery" and "Fortitude" Field Skills. It is unlocked at the same time as Tirkin Kountess 1, Tirkin Kountess 3 and Tirkin Kountess 4 and rewards information on the whereabouts of the Kountess. Tirkin Kountess 4 is the only mission that is necessary to complete the quest.

Tirkin Kountess 4 is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Tantal during the Blade Quest Birds of a Feather, after defeating the Tirkin King in battle. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Ice Mastery" and "Fortitude" Field Skills. It is unlocked at the same time as Tirkin Kountess 1, Tirkin Kountess 2 and Tirkin Kountess 3 and rewards information on the whereabouts of the Kountess. This is the only mission that is necessary to complete the quest.
* Omulette (the Kountess herself) * Tirkin Kountess 1 (merc mission) * Tirkin Kountess 2 (merc mission) * Tirkin Kountess 3 (merc mission) * Tirkin Kountess 4 (merc mission)

Titan Battleship Fixes is a DLC Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild automatically after clearing the Merc Mission Lifeline to Temperantia, which is obtained after clearing the DLC Quest The Lone Watchman. The time required to complete this mission is 30 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 7 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Transport Mastery" and "Fortitude" Field Skills. It uniquely awards more Merc Points than other normal Merc Missions. Completing this mission will unlock the DLC Merc Mission Crossing Bridges.
Timell is an NPC in . He can be found at Port Anangham in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He is involved in the quest, "Lila's Location", during which he is found at the Turbine Tower.

Treasure may refer to: * Treasure Chest in * Treasure Box in * Treasure Deal in * Treasure Sensor (XCX) in * Treasure Trove in * Treasure Items in * Treasure Sensor (XC2) in * Container in * Supply Drop in * Relic in

Tiger! Tiger! IRL is a Challenge Battle in . It can be received from the Nopon Archsage in the Land of Challenge, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. This challenge takes place at the Little Garden of Tradition in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Torna's Finest is a Challenge Battle in . It can be received from the Nopon Archsage in the Land of Challenge, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. This challenge must be completed in order to unlock Shulk's level 4 Monado Enchant Battle Skill. This challenge takes place at the Olethro Playhouse in the Kingdom of Uraya.

Titan Battleship Assault is a Challenge Battle in . It can be received from the Nopon Archsage in the Land of Challenge, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. It provides the only Challenge Battle in which the player can control a character who is not within the main party. This challenge takes place in the Titan Battleship. During New Game Plus, this Challenge Battle is unavailable until Chapter 4 is started.
Top of the World is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located south of the Rhadamanthus Portal in the First Low Orbit Station.
Tora's Tribe is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located in the Old Factory's Central Control Room in the Empire of Mor Ardain. It features a conversation between Tora, Rex and Poppi QTπ.

Tornans are a race in . They come from the Titan Torna. They bear resemblance to Homs and Humans, having no noticeable differences in appearance, like Ardainians in the main game. Tornans are ancestors to both the Tantalese and Leftherians, the former of which took refuge in the Titan Genbu after Torna's destruction. As of the events of , the original Tornans are an extinct race.

The Trauv Igna (Japanese: , Torābu Igūna) is a quest-exclusive enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. It is a member of the Igna family, and can be found at level 60 in the Lud Cloudway: Fonsett of the Leftherian Archipelago during the DLC quest Bright Spark, alongside the Scram, Riot and Gigalid Ignas. This enemy drops no items.
Tiger Tail (Japanese: , Taigāteiru) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when wielding Uchigatana.
The Tornan King is a character in . He is the ruler of the Kingdom of Torna during the Aegis War, brother of Zettar and father of Addam.
To Cross a Desert (Japanese: , Sabakukoe no Junbi, Preparing the Desert Crossing) is a main story quest in . It can be received from Addam on Olnard's Trail in the Kingdom of Torna.

Titan's Roar (Japanese: , Kyoshinjū no Nodobue) is a Secret Area in . It is an outcrop located at a cliff near the waterfall that will become Varnax's Plunge in the northern reaches of Gormott, northwest of Hoary Weald Camp. The view overlooks a waterfall and Valafum Hill. There are no enemies here, although there is a Treasure Trove and a large old machine nearby.

The Tirkin Cliff Colony (Japanese: , Tākin no Dangai Shūraku) is a landmark in . It is located southeast of Aletta: Militia Garrison in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna, on the edge of Wrackham Moor. There is a Treasure Trove and several Collection Points here, alongside several green barrels containing Red Pollen Orbs and the key item Collection Points for Panacellin required during The Malcontent Doctor. The Chestnut Slate Piece can be found here.

The Tornan Titan Interior (Japanese: , Īra Kyoshinjū: Tainai) is an area in . As its name suggests, it is a path through the interior of Torna. The Tornan Titan Interior is unique among the areas of as it has no Collection Points and no Quest-exclusive enemies or other quest activities. It does, however, have Treasure Troves and Unique Monsters as per the norm.

The Titan's Ulcer (Japanese: , Kyoshinjū no Byōsō) is a location in . It is located in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna, east of Dannagh Desert. Accessing it requires use of the Clean Up field skill (Level 3 Control Water and Level 3 Manipulate Ether), and inside it lies a Barney Stone. There are no enemies here other than those spawned by the Barney Stone, which come in waves: * 4 Survee Antol * 5 Survee Antol * 1 Greetz Antol

Torigoth Cemetery (Japanese: , Torigo-mura: Bochi) is a landmark in . It is located in the southeastern corner of Gormott. Here, fifteen graves of the citizens of Torigoth Village can be found, including one for Lora's mother. There are no enemies here except during a story event. After the events of , the cemetery reverts to nature, and 500 years later during the events of , it has become Torigoth Flower Patch in Gormott Province, just north of Kloom Farm.
Touch-Me-Not is the name of two distinct Arts: * Touch-Me-Not (XC2) * Touch-Me-Not (TTGC)

Tizza Parisax (Japanese: , Tizā Parasu) are Quest-exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Parisax family and can be found at level 38 in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna, in The Braying Canyon. Twelve of them must be fought during Further Feeding Issues, after which three will remain permanently in the canyon, and attack the party, regardless of level, unless Pestronella Oil is being used as a Pouch Item. As with all Quest-exclusive Enemies in , Tizza Parisax drop no items, only gold.
Trail of Destruction is a quest in . It can be received from Nittle near the Aureus Palace in Auresco, the capital of the Kingdom of Torna.

Timid Volffs (Japanese: , Dimido Vorufu) are three quest exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Volff family and can be found at level 9 at the Secluded Boneway in the Lasaria Region of the Kingdom of Torna, along with a Picker Buloofo, during A Simple Errand. As with all quest exclusive enemies in , Timid Volffs drop no items, only gold.
Traveler's Charms are Charm items in . They can be created by Lora at Campsites.
Tornan Trouts are Fish collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna.

Tirkin Arrowheads are Enemy Part collectible items in . They can be mainly dropped by Tirkin enemies found at the Tirkin Cliff Colony in the Kingdom of Torna. They can also be dropped by the miasma residue Collection Point southwest of Lake Sarleigh.

|-|Normal = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Torrent Braids (Japanese: , Ryūsui no Kumihimo) are Weapon Accessories in . They can only be equipped by Lora and imbue her attacks with the Water element. All Battle Braid weapon accessories grant Lora, Jin and Haze a Double Attack effect that give their Auto-Attacks a chance to hit the enemy twice, effectively doubling their damage and recharge bonuses. This effect is the same as Cube-type accessories and can stack with them. The likelihood of the effect triggering is based on the rarity of the accessory.

Tonbre Rhoguls (Japanese: , Tenebure Rōguru) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Rhogul family and can be found at level 26 - 32 at The Braying Canyon and the Golden Twin Mesa in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna. Two must be defeated to unlock Minoth's level 3 Espada Blade Special.

Topopo is a DLC NPC in . He is a Nopon who can be found at the top of the Work Observation Tower of the Old Factory in the Empire of Mor Ardain where he must be looked for during the DLC Quest Industrial Sort of Tour.
Transcend (Japanese: , Toransendā, Lit. "Transcender") is Addam's Talent Art in .

Tranc is an NPC in . He is a Tornan shopkeeper who can be found at Formide Shopping Ward in the Kingdom of Torna. He runs the Capital Weapons shop. Tranc offers no quests, but his Community can be gained by speaking to him after completing A Rare Sense of Justice.
Tiger-Winged Helmet is a Key Item in . It can be crafted by Addam at Campsites.
Tlaloc's Location is an Info Item in . It can be bought from the Nopon Halfsage for 400,000 G, and causes the Golden Monster Mesmer Tlaloc to spawn in the Streamsand Corridor in the Dannagh Region.
Timur is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian soldier who is found at Goetuis Wharf #1 in the Indoline Praetorium, and later at Battlescar Cove in Temperantia.
Titan Helms L are heavy head armour in . They can be purchased from Time Attack for 5,280 Noponstones.
Titan Plates L are heavy torso armour in . They can be purchased from Time Attack for 10,560 Noponstones.
Titan Arms L are heavy arms armour in . They can be purchased from Time Attack for 4,220 Noponstones.
Titan Sabatons L are heavy feet armour in . They can be purchased from Time Attack for 6,330 Noponstones.
Titan Greaves L are heavy legs armour in . They can be purchased from Time Attack for 8,440 Noponstones.
Thunder Doom (Japanese: , Sandādūmu) is Pandoria's Level III Blade Special in .
Torrential Pain (Japanese: ) is Praxis's Level IV Blade Special in .

Traversal Skills (Japanese: , fīrudosukiru) are a mechanic in . Traversal Skills may be required to bypass obstacles. Some places can only be reached by walking on a tightrope or climbing a wall. Traversal Skills are be acquired through Hero Quests, with four skills that can be obtained. Places where Wall Climbing can be used are marked on the map with a pickaxe icon.

Timbercorn Cthinos (Japanese: , Kikaku no Kutinosu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Ellook family and can be found at level 61 at Ladras Way on Captocorn Peak. The Healing Rest Art can be earned by the Soulhacker class by defeating it.
Totutu is a Nopon NPC and a merchant in . Totutu can be found by the Seilas Terrace Camp Rest Spot in Rae-Bel Tableland.
Tidal Wave (Japanese: , Ioenami) is a Talent Art in . It is the Talent Art of the Tactician class.
Torchlight Hill (Japanese: , Hi no Oka) is a landmark in . It is located on Everblight Plain and is the first landmark visited in the game.
Transcendent Retreat (Japanese: , Taikan Ichibō) is a Secret Area in , located on Melnath's Shoulder.
The Titan Rock Camp (Japanese: , Kyoshinjūgan no Kyūsokuchi) is a Rest Spot in . It is located near Titan Rock at the Great Cotte Falls.

Titan Rock (Japanese: , Kyoshinjūgan) is a Location in , located at Great Cotte Falls. It appears to be made up of the remains of one of the smaller Titans used in the Kingdom of Uraya, with its horn extending over the falls.

The Tower Camp (Japanese: , Shikakutō no Kyūsokuchi) is a Rest Spot in . It is located inside the Archaic Tower in High Maktha Wildwood. Coming to this location with Nia in the party is a prerequisite for Grasping My Future.
|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Tool Belts are Accessories in and .

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Titanium Temple Guards are Accessories in and . The common variant can be purchased from the Drahaga Store. The legendary variant can be purchased at the Prize X-change Red, obtained from a Container at the Cascade Ferronis Hulk, or dropped by Night-Stalker Volodya. In , the common variant can be purchased from the Colony 9 Supply Office.

Torus Hollow (Japanese: , Enkan no Dōkutsu) is a Location in . It is a large cave located beneath Elaice Highway, with the entrance being located at Great Liente Shelf. The Cadion Cliffside and the Hidden Stash can be found at the end of the cave system.

Thunderclap Dalton (Japanese: , Raigeki no Daruton) is a Unique Monster in . It is a Speculatos type Kevesi Levnis, and can be found at level 43 in the Troop Reserve Section, on the 3rd Floor of Keves Castle. It forms the "The Black Triad" with Turbulent Martinez and Determined Vatslav. The Deflector Plate Skill can be earned by the Soulhacker class by defeating it.
The Tonic Waters (Japanese: , Iyashi no Kishibe, Healing Shore) is a Location in , located in Ribbi Flats.
The Tree Hollow Opening (Japanese: , Taiju no Horaana) is a Location in , located in High Maktha Wildwood. The Mysterious Raider is fought here during Imminent Illusion.
Transparent Dreams (Japanese: , Tōmeina Yume) is a Hero Quest in , dedicated to Fiona.
The Titan Rock Apex (Japanese: , Kyoshinjūgan no Senkaku) is a Location in , located on Titan Rock at Great Cotte Falls. It is the horn of the Titan whose remains form Titan Rock.
Tirkin Notebooks are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Aetia Region. They can also be produced from the Battlescar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Transcendent Tenderloins are Collectible items in . They can be found on the Loska Plateau in the Pentelas Region. They are used to make Manana's Battle Soup DX.
Towering Lilies are Collectible items in . They can be found in Swordmarch. They can also be produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation.
Tirkingrass are items in . They can also be produced from the Cascade Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Tiiko Shooxes are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Shoox family, and can be found at level 44-45 in Erythia Sea.
Tikhta Ottils are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Ottil family, and can be found at level 60-61 at Cape Arcaphor in the Erythia Sea.
To Face Forward is a Standard Quest in , dedicated to Fiona.
Tohma (Japanese: , Touma) is an NPC in who can be found in Agnus Castle.
Thunder Steel is a Talent Art in . It is the Talent Art of the Lost Vanguard class.
Tilpa Scree (Japanese: , Tirupa no Iwaba) is a Location in . It is located on Rae-Bel Tableland in the Fornis Region.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Titanium Supports are Accessories in and . It boosts the user's agility by a set amount when worn. It is used to complete Seeker's Collectopaedia Card. The common variant can be purchased from Handypon, and the legendary variant can be bought from Prize X-change Red or dropped by Keen Chicky-Chicky. In , the common variant can be purchased from the Colony 9 Supply Office.

Titanic Bee Hives are Key Items in . Four are found to the south of the Perimeter Outlet in the Perimeter Woodland of Li Garte Prison Camp, while six are received from Eilis. Ten are needed for the quest A Chance Encounter, where they are used to repair Eilis's Levnis.
The Torpedo Wrap is a Key Item in . It is sold at Runaeda Torpedo Wraps for 100 G during Unsolved Riddle.

Toroidal Origin Shards are Key Items in . They are Origin Shards. They are used to Upgrade Blades and enhance Crafted Accessories. They can be purchased for 9,000 red Noponstones at the Prize X-change Red, and 1,800 blue Noponstones at the Prize X-change Blue.
The Tirkin Groom is an NPC in who can be found in The Tirkinhold at High Maktha Wildwood, and is a member of the Tirkins Colony.
The Towaris Taos is a Quest Exclusive Boss in . It is a member of the Taos family, and is fought at level 31 in Nih'l Valley in the Eagus Wilderness during Jeremy's Request. It drops the Keen Beak.
Titan Fists (Japanese: , Gigantikkunakkuru) is a Battle Art in . It is one of Lanz's Ouroboros arts.

Totoma is a NPC in . He is a Nopon from the Nopon Caravans who is found at the Namba Mound Camp in the Dannagh Desert after the DLC Quest Champion of the Nopon has been completed. After completing the quest Going Full HD, speaking to Totoma will allow the party to upgrade their HD Ether Cylinders+.

Transient Bond is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Superboss Seraphic Ceratinia while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Toxic Gas is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Spectral Rémy while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.
Toxin is a Status Effect in and . It causes the affected character to take damage over time.

The Tranquil Bluffs (Japanese: , Seijaku no Dangai) is a Secret Area in . It is located in a cave at the northeastern-most part of Raguel Lake on The Ragmos Desolation. Tranquil Bluffs was originally Tranquil Grotto on the Bionis' Leg in , but has since opened to the sky. Erythia Sea can be seen from here.
The Torpedo Wrap Recipe is a Key Item in . It allows the party to cook Ftheri Torpedo Wraps at Rest Spots. It is obtained upon completing Cooking with Rex, Part 3.
Torta Fossils are Fossil Collectibles in . They can be found on the Aurora Shelf. They are fossilized Tortas.
Tootshrooms are Mushroom Collectibles in . They can be found on the Aurora Shelf.
Tiny Timtim is a Nopon NPC in . He can be found at the Elevator Landing Camp on the Aurora Shelf. His Community is gained when talking to him after fully upgrading the X-Reader.
|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Torchlight Rings are Accessories in .
Tokilos (Japanese: , Tokirosu) is a family of avian enemies in and . They are close to Taos but come in a blue variety. In other games, only Taos appear but come in two red and blue varieties.

Totems (Japanese: , Pōru) are a recurring enemies in the . They are a family of enemy in , , and . They buff Tirkin enemies in a similar manner to Standards belonging to other humanoid enemies like Ignas.

Time to Fight! (Bionis' Shoulder) is a track in , composed by Kenji Hiramatsu. It is track twelve of disc 5 on the Xenoblade Definitive Edition Original Soundtrack and the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays when the party engages an enemy in battle. In , a remix of this song, known as Brilliant Wings, plays when Melia is used in battle if the "Special BGM" setting is enabled.
The Tower of Eternity is a landmark in . It is located at the center of Volitaris. There is an elevator here that leads to the final battle against Void.
Trampler Puge (Japanese: , Jūrin-gata Berude) is a Tyrant in . It is a member of the Puge family. It can be found at level 52 in Volitaris.
Tivio is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti who can be found on the outskirts of the Admar Storage Zone in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
The Tissue Sample is an Important Item in . It is collected from the White Whale debris at the North Coast in Oblivia during the course of Meeting Yelv.
The Traditional Orphean Drug is an Important Item in . It is collected from Sun'barac in the starboard of the Ma-non Ship during the course of The Party Line.
Tora's Secret Stash is a quest in . It can be accepted from Tora when he gives the party the Pretty Core Crystal in his house in Torigoth of the Gormott Province after he and Poppi join the party.
Torvin is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who can be found at the top of Bathein Watchtower in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Trebbi is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti who can be found in the Refugee Campground in the Indoline Praetorium after throwing 500 G from Milama Viewpoint.
Trading is a mechanic in and . The party can interact with a NPC in order to perform a trading. Several items can be traded.
Titanium Ralzes are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Dual Swords. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 5,300 Credits.
Titanium Knives II are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Knives. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 6,400 Credits.
Titanium Knives III are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Knives. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 4,300 Credits.
Titanium Candelas II are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Photon Sabers. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 9,000 Credits.
Titanium Candelas III are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Photon Sabers. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 9,000 Credits.

Tiwitiwi is an NPC in . She is a Nopon who can be found on the Salvage Deck in the Argentum Trade Guild during the day. She offers the Merc Mission Salvaging Security. She shows an avid interest in the art of salvaging, giving the party information on Cylinders and other equipment, but has a timid personality that prevents her from becoming one herself.
Tuzu (Japanese: , Tsuzure) is a Nopon in . She can be found in the Archaeology Centre in Frontier Village.

The Truth of the Giants is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is one of the three Giants' items found in the game, the others being the Daring of the Giants and the Heart of the Giants. These three items are required to open the door at Three Sage Summit, and are required for The Giants' Treasures and The Final Giants' Ruins. To obtain the Truth of the Giants, the following chain of quests from Tephra Cave must be completed: * The Book of Bafalgar * The Blood of Bafalgar * The Path of Bafalgar * The Coffin of Bafalgar * The Gratitude of Bafalgar

Tropical Radishes (Japanese: , Toropikaru Daikon) are collectables in . They can be found in the Eryth Sea and Colony 6. According to their description, they reveal a tropical colour when the inky-black clay is brushed off and they are considered sweet. Four are required for Cook-Off Comeback?.

Tweet Tweets (Japanese: , Piyopiyopoyopiyo) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found in Mechonis Field and later in Colony 6. According to their description, Riki was chirping when he named them and they are weird feathery things that resembles a chick.

The Twisted Tree Gate (Japanese: , Nejirigi no Āchi ) is a landmark in . It is located in Makna Forest. It is comprised of two trees, twisted together in a similar manner to a gate; hence its name. It is located a short way down the path from Eks Watering Hole. It is just past here that the elevated pathways which lead to Frontier Village begin, so from here on there are a number of high level enemies around. There are also some Orluga just down the path around the start of the walkways.

The Twisted Gun is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is located in cave south of Daksha Shrine on the lower level of Bionis' Leg. The broken gun is necessary for Mementos of a Lost Son. It belonged to Cheryl's son. It is guarded by a level 76 Dark Hox, which can be fought or sneaked past.
Twin Tree Vests are light torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are woven from twin tree ivy, found in Makna Forest.
Twin Tree Trousers are light legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.

Trouble at the Plant (Japanese: , Koritsumuen no Puranto) is a quest in . It can be received by Jarack at the Ether Plant in the Eryth Sea. If Shulk is in the active party, he will comment. Accepting this quest triggers Punish the Hodes and Mend the Plant.

Trouble at the Lighthouse (Japanese: , Shōshinkuryo no Tōdai) is a quest in . It can be received from Shalen at the top of the Syrath Lighthouse at the Eryth Sea, while Melia is leading the party. After completing the quest, Melia's fourth skill branch, Reticence, is unlocked.
Ulna Passage (Japanese: , Kishin Shakkotsu Tsūro) is a landmark in . It is located on the lower level of the Fallen Arm.
Tude Jewel Shells are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by the Sacred Zagamei and Carbon Tudes, or temporarily traded for with Peppino during Stopping the Elopement.

Turbine Battle (Japanese: , Tābin Teishi Sakusen) is a Story Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is received automatically at the Main Control Room after accepting Supply Station Battle while progressing through the first basement floor of Galahad Fortress.

Tumultuous Felix (Japanese: , Dotō no Ferikkusu) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a member of the Igna family, and can be found at level 27 on the cliff southeast of the Silent Obelisk in Satorl Marsh. It can drop an Igna Stone Pot, which is needed for Nopon Determination.

Turbulent Belmo (Japanese: , Ōuzu no Berumo) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Hiln family, and can be found at level 36 on Hovering Reef 1 at the Eryth Sea. It will engage the party if any Hiln is under attack close to it. It is the strongest Hiln in the game. It will drop a Hiln Coin Purse, three of which are needed to complete Eryth Sea's Collect Quest 1.

The Ultra Small Reactor is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward when Colony 6 Housing, Commerce, Nature, and Special have all been restored to level 1. The Ultra Small Reactor can then be given to the Gem Man at the Gem Man's Stall in Colony 9 to complete The Gem Man's Invention, for which the party receives a Mobile Ether Furnace, enabling them to craft gems anywhere. This option can be accessed by opening the menu palette, selecting the items menu, and then selecting Gem Crafting in the items sub-menu. This option is grayed out and inaccessible until the quest is completed.
Ugly Volffs (Japanese: , Agurī Vorufu) are enemies in . They are members of the Volff family, and can be found at level 15 in the Volff Lair on Bionis' Leg.

Twin Flamii Eggs are rare materials in . They are dropped by the Flamiis in Satorl Marsh, but are not available for trade. According to their description, they are two eggs laid simultaneously, one which holds the yolk, and the other holds the white. Two of them are needed for Preventing Starvation.
Turn Strike (Japanese: , Tān Sutoraiku) is Shulk's Talent Art in . It is only used with the Junk Sword, prior to obtaining the Monado. It inflicts Break for ten seconds.
Twisted Legs are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by the Lelepago Pterix or Kukukoro Flamiis, and be traded for with Rizaka.
True Natures (Japanese: , Shinjō no Hatsuro) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at Apex Lake in Frontier Village, between Dunban and Melia at green affinity.

Tyrea's Mask is a light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. Since she disconnected all the transporters in Alcamoth, after defeating the Fogbeasts in Gran Dell, Tyrea offers her mask to Melia in order to be able to reach the Imperial Villa and fight the Fog King.
Trident Buster is a Melee Battle Art in . The caster throws their electrically-charged Javelin, damaging enemies in a line in front of the caster.

The Turtle Nest (Japanese: , Tātoru Nesuto) is an Unexplored Territory in . It is located in Primordia in a cave at the end of a fjord near Biahno Hills. As with all Unexplored Territories, its discovery yields an achievement ("Scouting the Turtle Nest"). The Turtle Nest must be discovered to complete Off the Record (archaeological) in the .

True Stream Edge is one of Nagi's two Signature Arts in . Cross can learn it after completing Nagi's Time. It strikes five times and increases TP with every hit if the Morale Level is 1 or higher. Small enemies can also be launched from the hits.
The Twin Arches (Japanese: , Tsuin Āchi) are a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Oblivia, east of Oblivia Ingress and south of Big Arch.

Tree Scirpos (Japanese: , Tsurī Shirunea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Scirpo family, and can be found at level 11-20 in Primordia. Level 11-12 Tree Scirpos can be found at Seaswept Rise, while level 19-20 Tree Scirpos can be found at the Silent Mire.

Tutura (Japanese: , Tutura) is a Ma-non in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the entrance of the BLADE Tower in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. He is the founder of the Arms Manufacturer Candid & Credible.
Tripod Rock BC (Japanese: , Kanaeiwa BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a BLADE base camp located at Tripod Rock in Noctilum.
The Twin Hammers (Japanese: , Futago Tsuchiiwa) are an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are located in Noctilum, above the Great Nail. FN Site 215 can be found at the base of the east hammer.
Trigger Happy is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Winged Viper at rank 5.

Tripod Rock (Japanese: , Kanaeiwa) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Noctilum, north of the Humdrum Peaks and northeast of Goblin's Narrow. There is a small pond of poisonous water on the west side of the rock.

Trevor is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found by the BLADE Barracks in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. He can be found on Primordia's West Gate Plain during A Painful Lesson. He is a member of the Interceptors.

The Twin Qmoeva (Japanese: , Towin Kumūba) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Ganglion Qmoeva piloted by TW772: Trinn and fought at level 30 at Bandits' Refuge in Cauldros during Rites of Ruin.

Trump Papils (Japanese: , Toranpu Papirio) are five Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Papil family, and can be found at level 16 - 17 at Needle Rock Sandsea in Sylvalum. They must be defeated using the Ramjet Rifle during Weaponized.

The Trump Arenatect (Japanese: , Toranpu Rorongu) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Arenatect family, and can be found at level 16 at Needle Rock Sandsea in Sylvalum. It must be defeated using the Ramjet Rifle during the A route of Weaponized. It will not be fought if the B route is taken.

US-X Space Suits (Japanese: , Supēsusūtsu US-X) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia, in particular the beach around FN Site 111 and on the Primordia Waters north of FN Site 113. Six of them are needed for A New Audience.

Two Peas in a Pod (Japanese: , Futari no Gijutsusha, Two Engineers) is an Affinity Mission in . It can be accepted in the BLADE Barracks in New Los Angeles. Upon completing this mission, the party receives the newly developed Hexad-Partican Skell superweapon and three schematic FILEs enabling level 30, 50, and 60 versions to be developed at the AM Terminal.
True Queen Qmoevas (Japanese: , Turūkuīn Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Ganglion Qmoevas and can be found at level 41-50 in Cauldros's Sunset Falls.
Ultra Filters (Japanese: , Happī Wōtā) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia. Five are required for the B route of Water Woes.
Trying Crowns (Japanese: , Surō Kuraun) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum.

Tricolored Ovis Meats are common materials in . They can be obtained from Ovis.

Truppe, the Ceaseless Dark (, Tokoyami no Toruppe) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Petramand family. It can be found at night at level 53 at Old Ceremonial Hollow in Cauldros, at the end of the last corridor to the southwest. It must be defeated for Squad Mission No.15.
Typhoon Auravises (Japanese: , Taifūn Akuira) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Auravis family, and can be found at level 47-50 on Oblivia's Keegan Ridge.
Turquoise Arenatects (Japanese: , Tākoizu Rorongu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Arenatect family, and can be found at level 41-50 at Badr Basin in Sylvalum.
Turtlenecks are casual torso armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They share their appearance with the Ultra Limited Turtleneck.
Troylan (Japanese: , Toroiran) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found at the Port Side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.
The Tykki Sap is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It must be collected during Mystery Man at the Waterway Tangle in Noctilum.
True King Qmoevas (Japanese: , Turūkingu Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Qmoeva machines, and can be found at level 51-52 at Anvil Rock One and Anvil Rock Two in Sylvalum.
Ultra Limited Turtlenecks are casual torso armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are an upgraded version of the regular Turtleneck.

Trigo Bamboth (Japanese: , Dorigo Banboddo) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Cavern Clan Prone, lieutenant of Team Slovity and can be found at the East Gate in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.

Turf War (Japanese: , Koshō no Gen'in, The Cause of Trouble) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Enrai at the West Gate in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles. Although not a prerequisite, the Basic Mission A Question of Causes can be used to locate this mission.
Two Warriors (Japanese: , Futari no Bujin) is a Normal Mission in . It can be received from Go Belg at night in the Wrothian Stronghold in Oblivia.
Turba Tracker is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Interceptors and the primary destination is Sylvalum.

The Trigger Scintimure (Japanese: , On Torizumo) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Scintimure family, and is fought at level 46 at Infernal Ledges in Cauldros during Bozé's Ignorance.
The Trident-Anchor is a superweapon for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X.

Turquoise Metal are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Ahama's Seidr, or for 138 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in Art Draw Surge XV and XX augments.
Turba Nectar is a common material in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from red Turbas. They are required to engineer the Extend Aura augments.
Turba Straws are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Turbas.
Turba A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a red turba variant. It can be obtained from Tormenta, the Scarlet-Clad in Noctilum.
Turba B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a blue turba variant. It can be obtained from Feld, the Indigo-Clad in Sylvalum.
Ultimate Technique is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Gi Zang poised for battle during The Lurker. It is obtained as a reward for completing this Normal Mission.

Twins Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Candid & Credible Dual Swords. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Close Encounters. The Twins weapons available in-game are: * Archetype Twins * Iron Twins * Carbide Twins * Chrome Twins * Chromoly Twins * Cobalt Twins * Diagonal Twins * Original Twins * Titanium Twins * Ceramic Twins * Diamond Twins

Twisted Giant Trees is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.3, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of collecting five Fauna. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Ultra Limited Tank Tops are casual torso armors made by Sakuraba Industries in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are available through several missions. All colors in this set have the same stats.

True Comms are BLADE head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are based on the armor worn by Elma's true form, and are only available through crafting. Crafting Requirements *Chapter 12 completed * 1000 Miranium * 1 Golden Yggralith Heart * 2 Yggralith Gold * 30 Noble Yggralith Scales * 2 Dagahn's Adamant Bands * 5 Fossilized Bones * 7 Unlucky Black Whiskers * 1 Foucaultium

Twin Dolls of Mystery is a Time Attack Mission in . It features level 50 versions of the twin Skells Neilnail Albus and Neilnail Furvus, who, in the Wii U version, otherwise are only fought in the Squad Mission The Unknown Threat. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Ultra Nebulan Sniper Rifles II are ranged weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Sniper Rifles made by Sakuraba Industries.

The Trial Assault Rifle is a one-of-a-kind ranged weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a level 20 Assault Rifle obtained during the course of the Normal Mission Proficiency Exam 7. It must be used to defeat three Giant Grexes. It cannot be sold or discarded, even after the mission is completed. L's Shop cannot be used to add more Augment slots.

The Trial Knife is a one-of-a-kind melee weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a level 20 Knife obtained during the course of the Normal Mission Proficiency Exam 7. It must be used to defeat three Giant Grexes. It cannot be sold or discarded, even after the mission is completed. L's Shop cannot be used to add more Augment slots.

The Trial Sword is a one-of-a-kind melee weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a level 20 Longsword obtained during the course of the Normal Mission Proficiency Exam 7. It must be used to defeat three Giant Grexes. It cannot be sold or discarded, even after the mission is completed. L's Shop cannot be used to add more Augment slots.
